author: Olga
text:
In October 2026 in Marmaris I took part in a regatta led by Igor and Sofa, and it was mind-blowing, let me tell you.
I'll start with the fact that when Igor suggested I take part, I thought it was a joke - at that point I barely knew what the ropes on a yacht are called (and I still don't know them all) or where the wind is blowing from (still have trouble with that too) and, naturally, I decided he was joking - what regatta?
But the idea stuck, I couldn't shake it off and I decided to take the risk - when would I ever get a chance like that again? And I never regretted it once.
Our team turned out big and mixed, some already had an international licence and some were on a boat for the first time. Igor began by assigning roles at the first training session, who is responsible for what. I don't know how he managed to work it out at first glance, but the roles were assigned, in my view, perfectly, nobody complained and nobody wanted to swap afterwards.
All in all, Igor is the best captain in the world forever. Exceptionally courteous (I never once heard him raise his voice), exceptionally patient, ready to explain the same thing a hundred times, and exceptionally reliable. I can't describe it clearly, he just has this vibe of reliability. Sofa - a captain and a charmer! - is always ready to help, was in charge on the foredeck, went up the mast without hesitation when a snapped halyard needed replacing, and kept the photo log, for which special thanks, because personally I was so overwhelmed by emotions that I kept forgetting to take pictures.

All in all, it was the coolest, most thrilling adventure of the last few years.
Guys, you are the best!
Thank you so much for inviting me, for being positive and patient and for bringing our team together.
I wish you success and a huge number of victories! If you ever decide to organise something like this again - I'm yours forever!
